papers.title: CNM: An Interpretable Complex-valued Network for Matching
papers.identity_evidence: PDFp1 exact title/authors Qiuchi Li, Benyou Wang, Massimo Melucci; footer Proceedings of NAACL-HLT2019,pp4139-4148,June2-7,2019. Ten-page official ACLAnthology N19-1420 PDF, matching Crossref DOI10.18653/v1/N19-1420.
findings: P2 eq2 and p3 eqs3-5: complex unit word states, mixtures of projectors, rank-one Born-rule measurements; these NLP primitives precede Q-RMEA.
P4 eq6: local-window density mixtures with softmax word-norm weights. P5 section4.3 applies the same K trainable measurement directions to both question and answer windows.

P6 section5.2.2: directions unit-length; max-pool measured window probabilities then cosine matching. This differs from per-relation normalization over individual tokens followed by relation-specific value pooling.
The inspected sections do not establish that the complete current entity partial-swap head equals CNM, nor certify a task-beneficial difference.
limitations: Only pp1-6 read; interpretation ablations/references pp7-10 not deeply audited. No original code reproduction, reported metric certification or novelty clearance.

papers.title: Q-Interference: Memory-Efficient Phase-Aware Quantum-Inspired Attention
papers.identity_evidence: PDFp1 title and six authors match resolved arXiv record; footer arXiv2608.17288v1[cs.CL]18Aug2026 and Preprint. Twenty-five-page versioned arXiv PDF, not claimed accepted publication.
findings: Pp3-4 eqs2-5: amplitude-phase query/key score sum_r aq*ak*cos(phi_q-phi_k), ordinary causal softmax and value pooling.
P4 eq5 explicitly uses two standard matrix products via cos(alpha-beta)=cos(alpha)cos(beta)+sin(alpha)sin(beta), preserves dense T-by-T score memory; no removal of all quadratic attention cost.

This is a real part of a complex inner product, equivalently dot product of concatenated cosine/sine features (a direct inference from its eqs4-5). No new factorization or broad classical superiority is claimed here.

Its inspected model has no current entity-span partial-swap density effect or cyclic three-state trace. Structural difference alone does not establish novelty or task usefulness; no exact whole-model equivalence alleged.
limitations: Only pp1-5 read; AppendixB proofs and experimental outcomes not audited. Preprint claims not treated as our reproduced evidence.
